international.canonicalTopic: International Day of Clean Air for Blue Skies
international.headline: The Clean Air for Climate Action theme marks Clean Air for Blue Skies Day

The 2026 theme given is “Clean Air for Climate Action”.
The notes associate the observance with UNEP and the UN General Assembly and identify its purpose as reducing air pollution and improving air quality.
international.summary: The day promotes action on air pollution, with the 2026 theme linking clean air and climate action.
international.prelimsTakeaway: International Day of Clean Air for Blue Skies is September 7; the notes give the 2026 theme as “Clean Air for Climate Action”.
international.mainsAngle: Connect air pollution control with climate action and public health.

national.headline: Amit Shah chairs 28th Western Zonal Council meeting in Goa
facts: Union Home Minister Amit Shah chaired the 28th Western Zonal Council meeting in Panaji, Goa, on September 7, 2026.
Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa and the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu participated; the Inter-State Council Secretariat organised the meeting.
The meeting addressed inter-state coordination, regional issues and cooperative federalism.

Zonal Councils are statutory advisory bodies constituted under the States Reorganisation Act, 1956; the Union Home Minister chairs them and member-State Chief Ministers serve as Vice-Chairpersons by rotation.
Andhra Pradesh is a member of the Southern Zonal Council, along with Telangana, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu and Puducherry.
national.summary: The 28th Western Zonal Council meeting in Panaji brought together its participating States and Union Territory to discuss coordination and regional cooperation.
national.staticLink: Zonal Councils provide a forum for the Centre, States and Union Territories to discuss inter-state cooperation and administrative coordination.
national.prelimsTakeaway: Andhra Pradesh belongs to the Southern Zonal Council, not the Western Zonal Council.
national.mainsAngle: Zonal Councils provide an institutional mechanism for cooperative federalism and inter-state problem-solving.
national.apLink: Andhra Pradesh is a member of the Southern Zonal Council.

national.canonicalTopic: International Film Festival of Jammu and Kashmir
national.headline: First International Film Festival of Jammu and Kashmir held in Srinagar
facts: The International Film Festival of Jammu and Kashmir was held at Sher-i-Kashmir International Convention Centre, Srinagar, from September 7–10, 2026, under the theme “Rang-e-Cinema.”
The Department of Information and Public Relations, Government of Jammu and Kashmir, organised it in collaboration with the National Film Development Corporation of India (NFDC).
The festival aimed to provide a platform for cinema, filmmakers and creative-industry professionals, and to promote cultural exchange and Jammu and Kashmir as a film-production destination.
The festival’s stated focus also included the regional film ecosystem, cultural tourism and the creative economy.
The NFDC was established in 1975 and functions under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.
national.summary: The Srinagar festival brought together cinema and creative-industry participants, with an emphasis on cultural exchange and the region’s film ecosystem.
national.staticLink: The NFDC promotes Indian cinema, particularly quality and independent films.
national.prelimsTakeaway: The festival theme was “Rang-e-Cinema”; it was organised by Jammu and Kashmir’s Department of Information and Public Relations with NFDC.
national.mainsAngle: Examine how cultural industries and film-production ecosystems can contribute to regional tourism and economic activity.

national.headline: Telangana cities and wards receive honours in Swachh Vayu Survekshan 2026
facts: The 5th Swachh Vayu Survekshan Awards–2026 were presented on September 7, 2026, the International Day of Clean Air for Blue Skies.
Ward No. 16 of Nalgonda ranked second nationally among wards with populations below 10,000.
Among Category-3 cities with populations below 3 lakh, Sangareddy ranked eighth with 186.8 points and Nalgonda tenth with 185.8 points.
Hyderabad ranked nineteenth nationally among Category-1 cities with populations above 10 lakh, scoring 174.2.
Swachh Vayu Survekshan is linked to the National Clean Air Programme, launched in 2019 to improve ambient air quality.
national.summary: The 2026 survey recognised Telangana wards and cities for air-quality-related performance, with several placements reported in national categories.
national.staticLink: The National Clean Air Programme was launched in 2019 to improve ambient air quality.
national.prelimsTakeaway: Nalgonda’s Ward No. 16 was second nationally in the below-10,000 population ward category.
national.mainsAngle: Discuss how city-level assessment and recognition can support accountability and local action on ambient air quality.

national.canonicalTopic: India target for international medical-value tourists
national.headline: India sets annual target of 10 million international medical-value tourists
facts: At the Sanjeevani–2026 Expo in New Delhi on September 7, 2026, Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal set a target of attracting 10 million international Medical Value Tourists annually.
The notes state that around 3.5 million international patients had used Indian healthcare services over the previous seven years.
Hospitals were advised to disclose treatment prices transparently and register on the Government’s Heal in India online gateway.
International patients were encouraged to use hospitals accredited by the National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers (NABH).
national.summary: The Government set a 10-million annual target for international medical-value tourists and highlighted the Heal in India gateway and hospital accreditation.
national.prelimsTakeaway: NABH is a constituent board of the Quality Council of India; Heal in India promotes India as a medical and wellness tourism destination.
national.mainsAngle: Medical-value tourism links healthcare capacity, quality accreditation and transparent pricing with services exports.
